title: ACIS-history traversal index compaction
scope: Remove duplicate per-node visited membership storage from ACIS-history proxy traversal.
Preserve repeated-owner skipping and conflicting-owner rejection, including cycles.

sourceChange.before: Store first-seen handles and expected owners in one unordered_map, then also store every visited handle in a separate unordered_set.
sourceChange.after: Use the expected-owner map insertion result as the visited test; skip a repeated same-owner handle and reject a conflicting-owner handle.
sourceChange.effect: Removes one hash-set node per admitted history object while preserving traversal decisions and fail-closed cycle/owner behavior.

testChange.change: Added a generated history self-cycle case that keeps typed and raw reference handles consistent and requires refusal without destination publication.

focusedTests.coverageNote: The owning generated local DWG round-trip CTest runs the positive AC1027 proxy-history projection and malformed-edge matrix including the new self-cycle refusal.

validation.diffCheck: passed for dwg2dxf/dx_iface.cpp, tests/dwg_local_roundtrip_tests.cpp, DWG_DXF_OPEN_SOURCE_PARITY_PLAN.md, and this receipt

assessment.planImpact: Advances the 7S.2c repeated-work/storage audit with a generated cycle control; feature support, format behavior, test cadence, and external qualification remain unchanged. The implementation goal remains active.

testsRun: Strict local DWG round-trip target build
Owning generated local DWG round-trip CTest
method.limitations: This is a bounded in-memory traversal change; it does not establish whole-process memory, performance, DWG/DXF, or 3D support qualification.
